title: Unified Policy Editor — granular workspace policies and audit-first access flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype a unified Policy Editor inside Redwood Console that lets admins author workspace and org-level access policies, preview effective permissions per role, and run an "audit-first" access review flow. The editor will combine declarative policy rules (resource + action + condition) with a visual matrix, inline examples, and an audit timeline that surfaces recent grants, changes, and related audit-log events. Goal: reduce admin confusion when mapping high-level roles to concrete runtime access (API keys, Dedicated instances, Private endpoints) and make access reviews repeatable for security/compliance teams.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype includes an editor surface for creating rules with resource, action, subject, and optional condition fields
Prototype shows a real-time Effective Permissions preview for a selected user or role
Audit timeline panel surfaces matching audit-log entries (grant/revoke/role-change) with quick-revert links in prototype interactions
Design includes mobile and narrow viewport considerations for console-driven access reviews
Design spec documents integration points for backend: policy JSON schema, preview API, and audit-log query patterns
decisions: Favor explicit allow/deny rules with condition predicates rather than role-only editing to surface edge cases during audits
Preview will be computed client-side for small changes but fall back to preview API for bulk changes to avoid large client-side evaluation complexity
Initial release will support grant/revoke actions and not inline SAML/OIDC mapping; those will be surfaced as linked docs
We will represent time-scoped grants as first-class policy fields to support temporary access during incident response
updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff session with PM and Eng to align on schema and preview API boundaries
2026-03-01: Low-fidelity wireframes validated with two security-focused customers; feedback: need clearer revert affordance and export of review results
2026-03-04: Iterated on matrix view to add 'why allowed' microcopy explaining matching rule(s)
2026-03-08: Accessibility pass to ensure keyboard-driven policy creation and screen-reader labels for condition editors
2026-03-10: Design review with runtime and audit-logging teams; engineering requested explicit API contract and a safe-preview toggle for production environments
notes_for_engineering: Preview API should accept a draft policy blob and a subject identifier and return an allow/deny matrix
Audit timeline will need a searchable events endpoint filtered by policy id and affected subject
We recommend implementing optimistic locking for bulk edits and exposing a dry-run mode in the API
Provide a small sample dataset for front-end QA to populate the Effective Permissions preview
accessibility_considerations: All editor controls must be reachable via keyboard-only flows
Color use in matrices must meet 4.5:1 contrast; include patterned fills for colorblind users
Provide ARIA descriptions for condition builders and explainers
Ensure screen-reader friendly export of access review results
